from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from invoicing.models import Invoice, LineItem


def line(quantity=1, unit_price="10.00", sku="W-1", description="Widget"):
    return LineItem(sku, description, quantity, Decimal(unit_price))


def invoice(*lines, region="US", discount_code=None, number="INV-2026-0001"):

def test_merge_lines_adds_quantities_and_keeps_first_description():
    a = line(2, "9.99", sku="A", description="First")
    b = line(3, "9.99", sku="A", description="Second")
    assert merge_lines([a, b]) == (line(5, "9.99", sku="A", description="First"),)


def test_merge_lines_keeps_different_prices_separate():
    a = line(1, "9.99", sku="A")
    b = line(1, "8.99", sku="A")
    assert merge_lines([a, b]) == (a, b)


def test_merge_lines_order_of_first_appearance():
    a1 = line(1, "1.00", sku="A")
    b = line(1, "2.00", sku="B")
    a2 = line(4, "1.00", sku="A")
    c = line(1, "3.00", sku="C")
    result = merge_lines([a1, b, a2, c])
    assert [(l.sku, l.quantity) for l in result] == [("A", 5), ("B", 1), ("C", 1)]


def test_merge_lines_equal_prices_with_different_scale():
    result = merge_lines([line(1, "10.0", sku="A"), line(2, "10.00", sku="A")])
    assert len(result) == 1 and result[0].quantity == 3


def test_merge_lines_returns_tuple_and_does_not_mutate_input():
    lines = [line(1, sku="A"), line(1, sku="A")]
    result = merge_lines(lines)
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert [l.quantity for l in lines] == [1, 1]


def test_merge_lines_empty():
    assert merge_lines([]) == ()
